name: Abuse AI
description: AI-powered abuse management platform for hosting companies and ISPs.

APP_KEY.description: Laravel encryption key. Generate one with: php -r "echo 'base64:'.base64_encode(random_bytes(32));" — it must be set explicitly, because a dyno's filesystem is wiped on every restart and a regenerated key would make existing sessions and encrypted columns unreadable.

SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the seeded admin@abuseai.io account. Leave blank to get a random one printed in the deploy log (heroku logs --tail), then change it after your first login either way.

APP_URL.description: Your app's public URL, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com. Heroku only assigns it once the app exists, so set it after the first deploy — queued jobs and outgoing email need it to build absolute links.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for AI triage. Optional — add it later from the dashboard if you want to evaluate the UI first.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key, used when AI_PROVIDER=openai.

MANDRILL_KEY.description: Mandrill API key for outbound abuse notices.

ABUSEIPDB_KEY.description: AbuseIPDB key for IP reputation enrichment.
